calls.reason: R2I-Bench documents photorealistic progress and remaining reasoning weaknesses, but does not compare their improvement over time. ConceptMix++ also shows that prompt phrasing affects measured compositional performance.
The packet contains no independent record of Marcus's attempt or its ordering. His own account cannot establish that the failure occurred on his first try.

Apolinário's launch-day test reports failures on a full wine glass and a seven-fingered hand, alongside successes. Those concrete failures support the modest claim that compositional difficulties persist; Google also acknowledges detail limitations.
The packet contains no independent matched test of mechanical drawings. Google's overall editing ranking does not establish how Nano Banana compares with ChatGPT on part-whole correctness.

Davis's July tests show substantial improvement and several successful unusual-anatomy drawings. Remaining compositional failures do not clearly establish difficulty with basic biological facts, and no August anatomical test was verified.
